answer: Each agent publishes one Nostr event carrying the challenge hash to 3 relays within 10 minutes, signing it and weaving saffron, river, and delta into the content. Peers fetch the event from all 3 relays, check the Schnorr signature, hash, and timestamp. One honest agent holds 1 key and posts 1 event for a 150 POA bond, while 10 fakes must hold 10 keys and post 10 events across 30 relay slots, so costs rise 10X. A missing event, bad signature, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes offenders.
